profile.headline: Software Engineer | USC 2021
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer II at Visa with a proven track record of building high-performance, scalable systems that process millions of transactions daily. With expertise spanning backend architecture, frontend development, and cloud infrastructure, I specialize in turning complex technical challenges into elegant, efficient solutions.

What I Do:
I architect and optimize mission-critical systems handling 5M+ daily transactions with 99% SLA compliance. My work focuses on performance engineering, where I've achieved breakthrough results—2x performance improvements, 70-90% faster service startups, and 90% API optimization. I build systems that don't just work; they excel under pressure.
Technical Expertise:

Backend: Python, Java, TypeScript, Node.js, Spring Boot, Django, Flask
Frontend: React, Vue.js, Angular, Next.js, TypeScript
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, CDK, DynamoDB), Docker, CI/CD, Serverless Architecture
Databases: MySQL, DynamoDB, DB2, SQLite
Specializations: Performance optimization, distributed systems, RESTful APIs, microservices

My Journey:
With a Master's in Computer Science from USC and a Bachelor's in Computer Engineering from Gujarat Technological University, I've built a career solving problems that matter. From Amazon to startups to enterprise fintech, I've delivered products used by millions while mentoring teams

Beyond the Day Job - ZapSearch:
I'm passionate about developer productivity, which led me to create ZapSearch—a blazing-fast Chrome extension that brings Spotlight-style search to your browser. Available on the Chrome Web Store, ZapSearch lets users instantly search bookmarks, history, and perform quick Google searches with intelligent ranking based on usage patterns. Building and maintaining ZapSearch keeps me connected to end-users and reminds me why I fell in love with software development: creating tools that make people's lives easier.

Let's Connect:
Whether you're looking to discuss performance optimization strategies, cloud architecture, or just want to chat about building great developer tools, I'm always open to connecting with fellow engineers and innovators.
🔗 Portfolio: raj1998.github.io
💻 GitHub: github.com/raj1998
🚀 Check out ZapSearch on the Chrome Web Store

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved performance of a high SLA (99% transactions in 2 minutes) component (processing ~5M transactions daily) by 100% (2x faster) with existing infrastructure using dynamic thread scaling
• Optimized startup time of critical backend services by 70% to 90% - resulting in faster restarts during deployments
• Created an intuitive app for SRE to manage 100s of cron jobs - reducing manual intervention steps by 50% and decreasing troubleshooting time from hours to minutes
• Created Fraud Audit Logs Report generation feature using observable design pattern which can store the report in 2 different datastores based on user preference.  
• Automated the compromised accounts system data transfer using Quartz Framework saving 1-2 hours of manual work every month and Optimized the code to speed up 3 APIs by 90%
• Led a scrum team of 5 engineers for a quarter, improving team velocity by 25% and delivering all planned features on schedule with zero critical bugs. 
• Implemented 2 new flows for the Fraud Marking feature (used by Banks) in the Visa Risk Manager product and enhanced existing functionality for the same
• Mentored new team members and interns, accelerating their onboarding and enabling them to contribute to production code within their first month. Delivered several projects working with product, QA and SRE teams

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Architected and Integrated Popup builder into the existing Website builder which increases conversion rates
•	Improved and added new features to Grid-based Website builder tool which Increased page building speed by 40%
•	Created UI (Vue, React) and APIs for an admin dashboard which reduced demo account building time by 10 times
•	Feature flagged the existing codebase which will reduce development cost for prospective customers

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Created a Cards Marketplace application in native AWS for a Content Execution internal tool used in amazon.com 
•	As a part of my project, integrated data from 3 data sources managed by different teams
•	Used AWS CDK and Lerna to automate creation of backend infrastructures like AWS Lambda and API gateways 
•	Developed prefetch caching mechanism using DynamoDB and Serverless Lambda which reduced network calls by 8 times per page and increased page loading speed by 80%
•	Used TypeScript with NodeJS, ReactJS, and Jest for Unit testing (100% code coverage) in CICD workflow

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• RESTful API development for the products in Python and PHP
• Developed a cross-platform full stack mobile application in React Native with PHP backend
• Python Web Scraping with Beautiful Soup 4
• Developed user dashboard using PHP, MySQL
• Web designing in Bootstrap 4 and code refactoring for old design

projects.title: ZapSearch
projects.description:
ZapSearch is a Chrome extension for doing Spotlight Search in Chrome Browser.
It can perform a ⚡️ Blazing fast ⚡️ search for Bookmarks, History, and Special commands.
ZapSearch ⚡️ improves your experience of the Chrome browser and increases your productivity.

Forget about leaving your keyboard for searching in bookmarks, history, or doing certain tab operations by launching ZapSearch with HotKey Command+Shift+L or Ctrl+Shift+L

🔥 Features:
▶︎ Search Bookmarks
▶︎ Search History
▶︎ Quick Google Search
▶︎ 📍 Ranking based on number of times item searched
▶︎ Commands for Tabs

projects.title: Smart RSVP
projects.description:
Smart RSVP web app for counting event attendees using a QR code on the invitation card.
The host of the event can generate these QR codes while insertion of records in DB.
Each QR code has a unique string generated by MD5 hash. This app is hosted on Heroku .

Code: https://github.com/Raj1998/smart-RSVP
Live: https://django-app-241.herokuapp.com
